freeEntryRule: Worker submit is free for the first 5 submits per wallet per task until the task has 50 total submissions; after that the fee is 0.001 of the payment token. A required stake is also not free entry.

methods.refresh: A scheduled build (GitHub Actions, hourly) fetches the official APIs on the runner, writes static JSON under /data, and publishes the site. Visible data-as-of is the build time. Rebuilds at least hourly.
methods.posters: Distinct posters per week are counted from requester addresses on /api/tasks (newest, last 8 weeks, no name lookup).
methods.openPaidTasks: Open tasks with a positive reward are listed from /api/tasks?status=open on each chain. Reward is the escrowed amount in token units (1e6). Free entry follows the public 50-submission fee rule. Default sort is opportunity: reward / (1 + submissions).
methods.sharedStats: Official breakdowns, time series, heatmap and activity feed are platform-wide (identical for every chainId). market/stats shares registeredWorkers, 7d actives and openTasks; paidWorkers and activeWallets are per-chain and summed in the combined view (a wallet paid on both chains is counted twice).
